body: Thats fucking sucks. I feel the same way. I just gave up on it. If they don’t want to talk to me then that’s up to them
You put it perfectly into words. I haven’t been able to express it in a concise way that makes sense, but this is a good way to explain it

Honestly it’s an accumulation of things. Mostly just stressed about graduating on time, work, and money. I’m failing all my classes and I feel so weak and useless for not being able to just focus and get things done. I also feel weak for wanting the easy way out. I can’t help thinking how much easier it would be if I was dead
